title: Commissioner’s Note
lettering: Over the next three Sundays, somebody in this league will be rooting for you who hasn’t rooted for you all year. You may be the only team left on the schedule that can beat the club he’s chasing. That’s what a division owes its last-place team, and what the last-place team owes the division. Everybody gets your best starting ten. Especially the guy who thinks he’s earned an easy Sunday.

photographic_source.authority: New text-only generative set study of an anonymous hand, blank letter, capped pen and desk lamp.

brief: Extreme close desk composition; paper and an unidentified working hand. Unsigned reader proposal for layout review under the Closer’s direction. The actual Commissioner owns voice and signature.
